description:
List your saved post snippets, server-side sorted, filtered, and
offset-paginated. ``sort_col`` is one of ``favorite|created|updated|name``
(default ``favorite``); ``sort_dir`` is ``asc|desc``. ``search`` is a
case-insensitive regular expression matched against the snippet name or body.
``date_from``/``date_to`` accept bare ``YYYY-MM-DD`` (UTC-calendar day,
end-inclusive) or an ISO instant (patron-local midnight from the FE). Bound
the ``date_field`` column, one of ``created|updated`` (default ``created``).
``page`` is 0-indexed; ``page_size`` is 1..200. Free, owner-scoped. Returns
``{snippets:[…], total, page, page_size}`` reflecting the filtered set.

date_field.description: The date the bounds apply to: ``created`` or ``updated``.

date_from.description:
Lower bound on ``date_field`` — ``YYYY-MM-DD`` or an ISO-8601
instant; blank for none.

date_to.description:
Upper bound on ``date_field`` — ``YYYY-MM-DD`` (inclusive) or an
ISO-8601 instant; blank for none.

dpop_token.description: Proof that the caller holds npub. Either the grant envelope that receive_npub_proof returned, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235 Nostr event signed by npub: content "", a `u` tag holding this tool's exact name from tools/list, created_at within 60 s of now, and a random `nonce` tag.

npub.description: The patron's Nostr public key (npub1...). Tool fees are paid from this patron's balance; dpop_token proves the caller holds it.

search.description:
Case-insensitive regular expression matched against the
snippet name or body; blank matches all.

name: excalibur_list_snippets
title: List snippets
